stations.title: List helpers
stations.text: Work on any list, and forget its type.

captions: Bryn asks how many tins are in order OK-1043 at Oakhollow.
The helper found the order, and handed it back with its type forgotten.
You write helpers with a type parameter, so what comes out keeps its type.
Now the order comes back as an order, and Bryn reads its tins.
Every list helper hands back the type it was given, and none has a needless T.
